Follow [the contract](../../AGENTS.md) and [protocol](../../docs/agents.md).
Preserve original documents, permissions, audit and retention behavior. Respect
consent/unsubscribe and separation of approval duties. Capture all delivery
locally until separately approved; no live campaigns, qualified-signature claims
or provider signup. Return scoped tests and candidate SHA for independent QA.
